name: Researcher
text: Put in the items and packages a package needs and it is researched for the whole server. Pick what to research with a Package Reader. Hoppers and pipes work; by hand, use items on it. Age V.

name: Packager
text: Pick a researched package with a Package Reader, feed it the inputs, and it makes a package crate. Take crates out empty-handed or with a hopper. Age V.

name: Unpackager
text: Put a package crate in and it hands back the goods inside, many at once. Take them empty-handed or with a hopper. Age V.

name: Package
text: A sealed crate made by a Packager. Unpack it in an Unpackager.

name: Package Reader
text: Use on a bench to pick the next package it can work on. Sneak and use to clear the bench and get its items back.
